prerequisites: Having passed 50% of the study plan credits.

learning_outcomes.text: Is able to collaborate in a professional work team, assume responsibilities, collaborate in work organization, and be proactive in daily contingencies.

Is able to apply acquired knowledge in unknown contexts to develop proposals and solutions for engineering problems, using critical reasoning and creativity, and adapting to company/client regulations and requirements.
Is able to interact in engineering environments, both orally and in writing, to argue and justify their proposals and solutions to technical issues.

teaching_methods: Personal study, report writing, practical work, etc. as independent student or group work
assessment_rules: The evaluation considers the assessment by the company tutor and academic tutor on technical capability, learning, work administration, communication skills, responsibility, adaptability, creativity, initiative, personal involvement, motivation, receptiveness to criticism, punctuality, workplace relations, and teamwork. Additionally, a practice report, evaluated by the course coordinator, reflecting activities, assessments, and reflections on learning, is required.
